purpose: Separate coordinates only when current evidence or actuator distinctions make their collapse unsafe.

Q.name: stress/neuroendocrine/context state
Q.authority: source-supported context candidate; human AGA contribution incompletely validated

R.name: regenerative-state candidate
R.authority: cross-sectional orthogonal compatibility; not a validated scalar

P.name: functional progenitor-compartment/reserve candidate
P.authority: human cross-sectional multi-assay support; dynamic competence unvalidated

N.name: stem-cell/niche integrity candidate
N.authority: source-supported but not currently identifiable as one scalar

context_not_promoted_to_core_state.I: immune/microinflammatory context has source support but is not yet promoted to a unique dynamic latent coordinate because current evidence does not identify its independent state dynamics from E/P/context
context_not_promoted_to_core_state.V: vascular mechanism candidates exist, but the current frozen transcript observer was rejected

legacy_mapping.legacy_A: reduced abstraction that previously mixed upstream DHT exposure and downstream androgen-linked effects; unsafe for branch-specific actuator reasoning
legacy_mapping.legacy_F: reduced abstraction that previously mixed ECM remodeling, mechanics and synthetic hysteresis; unsafe for actuator-specific biological interpretation

migration_rule: Use the legacy 7-state model only for synthetic questions whose conclusions are invariant to the D/A_AR/M and E/M/F_hyst distinctions. Use v2 taxonomy when interpreting biological probes or actuator-specific responses.
